subject: Executive intro & CIO bridge — scheduling and sponsor prebrief
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@skyforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro & CIO bridge — scheduling and sponsor prebrief

Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for the time today. Morgan, we'd love to get a 45-minute technical demo in front of your CIO and one of our exec sponsors (VP-level) to discuss latency/cost considerations and the integration plan. High level ask: can your CIO attend so we can run through the architecture and TL;DR procurement needs up front?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Jun 21, 10:00–10:45 (best for our engineering lead)
- Thu Jun 22, 14:00–14:45 (fallback)

If neither works we can flex. If the CIO can make only part of the session we can do a 20–25 minute exec bridge at the top and deep dive the rest.

I attached a one-pager and a short demo brief to help your CIO prep (prebrief_onepager.pdf, demo-brief-v1.pptx).

Two asks from our side before the session: 1) a procurement contact for any contracting questions; 2) any immediate compliance gates (SOC2, data residency) we should call out on the agenda.

Proposed sponsor-only prebrief: Tue Jun 20, 16:00–16:30 PT (30m) — quick run-of-show and redlines. Can you confirm sponsor availability?

Thanks — I can hold the 21st for now if that helps.

Rachel Kim
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: prebrief_onepager.pdf, demo-brief-v1.pptx

Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyforge.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:04:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro & CIO bridge — scheduling and sponsor prebrief

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear options. The CIO (Clara Park) is available on Wed Jun 21 and prefers a morning slot — 10:00–10:45 PT works well. Alex (cc'ed) will coordinate logistics.

Procurement question: please loop in procurement@skyforge.com for contracting timelines. They typically need a SOC 2 report and a short description of data retention controls. Can you share a link to your latest SOC 2 and a brief agenda?

Also: would it be possible to get a 20-minute sponsor prebrief on Tue Jun 20 at 16:00 PT? The CIO wants to touch base with the VP sponsor first.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Morgan
Morgan Lee
Director, Cloud Platforms
SkyForge Inc.
morgan.lee@skyforge.com | +1 206-555-0987

Ben / Neha — quick internal checklist before Wed: 

- Ben: lead demo, prepare 10–12 minute exec summary to start, then handoff to eng for latency/cost deep dive. Please run a 20-minute dry run with engineering Tuesday morning (I put a placeholder).
- Neha: SOC2 link + one-page retention/audit-log summary for procurement. Put the PDF in the shared folder and drop a short blurb for procurement's review (procurement@skyforge.com).
- Rachel: I'll own the prebrief Tue 16:00 PT with Clara + our VP sponsor; Ben you should attend.

Make sure the demo deck highlights: integration points, routing fallback, caching strategy, and expected p95 latency under typical loads. Keep the first 10 minutes high level for the CIO (no more than two slides on infra).

Let me know if either of you can't make the dry run — otherwise I'll finalize invites and confirm DocuSign expectation (7–10 day review) with procurement.

Thanks — r
